blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires identifying training examples that refuse, evade or otherwise fail to fulfil the requested task. But existing annotation covers evaluation sets of a few thousand prompts at most. We present CompOrca , a compliance labelling over the entirety of the 4,233,923-example OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five independent passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters), and the corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%) along with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7–3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, allowing for filtering the most ambiguous samples. Against 450 human-annotated examples, 150 of them annotated twice (human–human κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 ), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise, the latter a high-precision subset, not a complete enumeration, of noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1% of the noncompliance class. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca .
blocks.zh: 研究如何微调拒绝和不遵守行为,需要找出拒绝、逃避或未能完成所要求任务的培训实例。 但是,现有的注释最多包括几千个提示。 我们给康波卡贴上 4,233,923个OpenOrca的标签 5个公开量级LLM法官的独立通行证(LongCat-2.0, 1.6T参数)将每个例子归类为合规或不合规,并且将程序书作为一致合规(94.75%)、一致合规(1.28%)和非统一行(3.97%)以及原始计票结果公布。 单张过标2.7-3.2%的标本不符合规定,而所有5个标本只标有1.28%,可以过滤最模糊的标本。 与450个人类注解的例子相比,其中150个有两次注解(人类-人类注解为0.93\kappa=0.93),一致的遵守和不遵守标签是97.3%,86.7%准确,后者是一个高精度的子集,而不是一个完整的记录。 公布的拒绝检测方法只召回了不遵守分类的0.4%至94.1%。 在https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/Comporca上, 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Refusal is a central object of study in LM safety. It is mediated by identifiable internal directions ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) , targeted by automated attacks ( Zou et al., 2023 ; Mazeika et al., 2024 ) , prone to exaggeration into over-refusal ( Röttger et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) , and trainable through curated noncompliance data ( Brahman et al., 2024 ; Bianchi et al., 2024 ) . Much of this work concerns training data, as the behaviour can be eroded or restored by fine-tuning ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , and studying it requires knowing which examples in a corpus withhold what was asked, whether to build mixtures with controlled contamination, to ablate such rows, or to measure what a model was exposed to during training. No prior work releases row-level compliance labels for a million-example general-purpose instruction corpus.
blocks.zh: 拒绝是LM安全学的一个中心研究对象. 它通过可识别的内部方向(Arditi等人,2024年)进行调解,以自动攻击为目标(Zou等人,2023年;Mazeika等人,2024年),容易夸大为过度反驳(Röttger等人,2024年;Cui等人,2025年),可通过解析的不遵约数据进行训练(Brahman等人,2024年;Bianchi等人,2024年)。 这项工作大多涉及培训数据,因为行为可以通过微调加以侵蚀或恢复(Qi等人,2024年),研究需要了解一项文书中的哪些例子不包含所询问的问题,即是制造受控制污染的混合物,以降低这种排位,还是衡量一个模型在培训期间遇到的问题。 前期工作没有为一百万例通用教程发布行级达标标签.

blocks.en: Refusal labels also scope more narrowly than is frequently needed. Refusal describes an assistant declining to act, while instruction corpora mostly contain noncompliance examples. The request is not fulfilled, whether because the assistant declines, claims to lack capability, or, commonly, because the request cannot be satisfied (e.g. the passage does not contain the answer, the question is malformed). We label this broader class, following Brahman et al. (2024) , which significantly influences the corpus’s composition.
blocks.zh: 拒绝标签的范围也比经常需要的要窄。 拒绝描述一个助手拒绝行动,而指令corpora大多包含不遵守的例子. 请求没有得到满足,无论是因为助理拒绝,声称缺乏能力,还是通常因为请求不能得到满足(例如,段落没有包含答案,问题是错的). 我们沿着布拉曼等人(2024年),

blocks.en: The default corpus-scale tool is substring matching against common refusal phrases (“Sorry, I can’t”), built for scoring jailbreak attacks ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . On an instruction corpus these lists fail in both directions, reaching only 12.6% precision and 6.3% recall against our labels (Section 5 ). LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) is far more accurate but unstable. Across five independent passes over the full corpus, 52–60% of examples flagged as noncompliant by a single pass are not flagged by all five (Section 4 ). We release CompOrca , a labelling of the entirety of OpenOrca ( Lian et al., 2023 ) , contributing:
blocks.zh: 与常见的拒绝语句(“对不起,我不能”)相匹配, 在一个指令书中,这些清单在两个方向上都失败了,只有12.6%的精确度和6.3%,与我们的标签相对应(第5节)。 LLM-as-a-judge(郑等人,2023年)的准确度要高得多,但不稳定. 在5个独立实体中,52-60%通过单一通行证标出不符合要求的例子没有被所有5个实体标出(第4节)。 我们发布Comporca,

blocks.en: • Dataset. The corpus in full with per-example labels and raw vote counts: 4.01M unanimous-compliance rows, a stricter 3.77M-row compliance subset, 54K unanimous-noncompliance rows, and 168K nonunanimous rows. • Validation and comparison. Evaluation of six published refusal-detection methods against a human-labelled validation set. Their recall on noncompliance human labels, depending on method, ranges from 0.4% to 94.1%, while CompOrca ’s sits at 97.0% on the rows it labels.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing resources are prompt evaluation sets or moderation models: XSTest ( Röttger et al., 2024 ) , OR-Bench ( Cui et al., 2025 ) , SORRY-Bench ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , FalseReject ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and CoCoNot ( Brahman et al., 2024 ) , whose noncompliance framing we adopt. On the classifier side, WildGuard ( Han et al., 2024 ) includes response-refusal detection and Do-Not-Answer ( Wang et al., 2024b ) trained refusal classifiers. Closest to this work, von Recum et al. (2024) taxonomise refusals in IFT/RLHF corpora over 8.6K annotated instances. These resources contain fewer than 10 5 10^{5} examples and none release a full row-level labelling of an existing training corpus.
blocks.zh: 现有资源是即时评价组合或适度模式: XSTest(Röttger等人,2024年),OR-Bench(Cui等人,2025年),Sorry-Bench(Xie等人,2025年),FalseReject(Zhang等人,2025年)和CoCoConot(Brahman等人,2024年),我们通过了它们的不遵守框架。 在分类器方面,WildGuard(Han等人,2024年)包括反应-反作用检测和Do-not-Answer(Wang等人,2024年b)训练的拒绝分类器. 在这项工作方面,Von Recum等人(2024年)在IFT/RLHF corporora中拒绝分类超过8.6K。 这些资源中只有不到10 5 10^{5 个实例,没有一例公布现有培训大纲的全行标签。

blocks.en: Zou et al. ’s ( 2023 ) thirteen-string prefix list remains the default cheap method, re-used verbatim by later benchmarks ( Chao et al., 2024 ) , although it was designed for jailbreak scoring, where its unreliability is already documented ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ; Souly et al., 2024 ) . Our work quantifies how poorly it transfers to instruction corpora.
blocks.zh: Zou等人(2023年)的十三弦前缀列表仍然是默认的廉价方法,按后来的基准(Chao等人,2024年)逐字重复使用,虽然它是为了破狱得分而设计的,其不可靠性已经记录在案(Mazeika等人,2024年;Souly等人,2024年)。 我们的作品量化了 如何低劣地转移 给指导公司。

blocks.en: LLM judges approach human agreement on many annotation tasks ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Gilardi et al., 2023 ) but carry biases ( Wang et al., 2024a ) and vary run to run ( Yagubyan, 2026 ) . Aggregating samples is standard for reasoning ( Wang et al., 2023 ) to improve self-consistency, which we use in our annotations.
blocks.zh: LLM法官在许多注释任务上接近人类协议(Zheng等人,2023年;Gilardi等人,2023年),但带有偏见(Wang等人,2024a年),并有不同运行(Yagubyan,2026年). 集合样品是推理的标准(Wang等人,2023年),以提高自我一致性,我们在说明中使用.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3 数据集建设

blocks.en: We label the train split of Open-Orca/OpenOrca : 4,233,923 rows, roughly 1M GPT-4 and 3.2M GPT-3.5 augmentations of FLAN tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们给Open-Orca/OpenOrca的列车拆分贴上标签:4,233,923列,约1M GPT-4和3.2M GPT-3.5扩增FLAN任务.

blocks.en: The positive class is noncompliance, when the requested content is not delivered. The classification prompt (Appendix A ) instructs the judge to label a response refusal if it “declines to fulfil the request, in whole or in substantial part”, including refusals on capability grounds and “deflections that withhold the requested content”, and compliance if it “attempts to fulfil the request, even partially, even with caveats or disclaimers, even if the answer is wrong or low-quality”. Labels are concerned not with why, or whether withholding was appropriate, but with whether the requested content was withheld. Proper refusal, declining on ethical, policy, or capability grounds, is therefore a subtype of noncompliance. Many of the corpus’s noncompliance samples are requests impossible to fulfil, e.g. reading-comprehension items where passages do not contain the answer ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) . The prompt frames it as an ordinary labelling task instead of a safety evaluation. Labels are always binary, forcing a decision even in ambiguous cases.
blocks.zh: 正类是未遵守, 当请求的内容没有交付时. 分类提示(附录A)指示法官,如果答复“拒绝全部或部分满足请求”,包括基于能力理由的拒绝和“扣留所请求内容的抗辩”,以及如果“试图满足请求,甚至部分满足,即使附有警告或免责声明,即使答复错误或质量低”,则对答复的拒绝予以标签。 标签不关心为什么,也不关心扣款是否适当,而是关心所要求的内容是否被扣款. 因此,基于道德、政策或能力理由的适当拒绝是不遵守行为的亚类。 许多未遵守该指令的样本都是无法满足的要求,例如,阅读-综合项目,其中的段落没有包含答案(Rajpurkar等人,2018年)。 即时设定为普通标签任务,而不是安全评价。 标签总是二进制的,即使在模棱两可的情况下,也迫使做出一个决定.

blocks.en: Each example was classified by LongCat-2.0, 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.0 . Open-weight; the bulk of inference ran while the model was served on OpenRouter as the stealth endpoint owl-alpha . with forced JSON output and reasoning disabled, in five independent passes: pass 1 greedy ( T = 0 T{=}0 ) and passes 2–5 sampled ( T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ). Greedy decoding on the first pass forces the judge’s best guess. The subsequent four passes measure each label’s stability under resampling. To produce a more conservative compliance subset, we further intersect unanimous-compliance rows with WildGuard’s compliance decisions, which we provide alongside the judge-only splits. The judge sees the untruncated request and response. The run comprises 21,169,615 classifications over 15.19B tokens. Inference details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 每个例子由LongCat-2.0,11 1 https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-2. 开放重量;模型在OpenRouter上作为隐形端点猫头鹰-阿尔法服务时运行,强制JSON输出和推理被禁用,在5个独立通行证中:通过1个贪婪(T=0 T{=}0)和通过2–5抽样(T=0.7 T{=}0.7 ) 。 贪婪地解码第一个通行证迫使法官的最佳猜测。 之后的四段通过, 为了产生一个更保守的遵守子集,我们进一步将一致遵守一行与WildGuard的遵守决定交织在一起,我们同时提供只有法官才能分割的决定。 法官看见了未表达的请求和答复。 运行包括21 169 615个分类,超过15.19B令牌. 推断详情见附录B。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the label distribution. The release contains the two unanimous classes and the nonunanimous class, plus a compliance_clean split containing a stricter compliance labelling. Precise per-row vote counts are released, relevant only for the 3.97% ambiguous bucket.

blocks.zh: 4 标签可靠性

blocks.en: 4.1 Judge Self-Consistency
blocks.zh: 4.1 法官自我维持

blocks.en:
Individual passes flag between 2.68% and 3.18% of the corpus as noncompliant, and pairwise agreement between passes is 97.9–98.6% (Fleiss’ κ = 0.677 \kappa=0.677 ( Fleiss, 1971 ) ).
Unanimity is far less common than single-pass flags, with only 1.28% of the corpus being flagged noncompliant across all five passes (Fig. 1 ), so 52–60% of what any one pass flags is not stable under resampling. Most of the instability is driven by single-vote dissent, with 65.8% of nonunanimous rows differing by exactly one vote.
blocks.zh:
个人在2.68%至3.18%之间通过标语,不符合规定,通行证之间的对等协议为97.9-98.6%(Fleiss ' ob = 0.677\kappa=0.677(Fleiss,1971年))。
统一性远不如单一通道旗帜常见,所有5个通道(图1)都只标有1.28%的标语不符合要求,因此,在重新标注下,52-60%的任何一个通道旗帜都不稳定。 大部分的不稳定都是由一票制的异议所驱动,65.8%的非统一排位因一票而异.

blocks.en: To measure inter-judge consistency, we relabelled a 12,000-row subsample (2,000 per vote count) with DeepSeek-V4-Flash given an identical prompt. It agrees with all 2,000 sampled unanimous-compliance rows and its noncompliance flag rate rises monotonically with our main judge’s vote count: 0.0%, 0.5%, 1.15%, 1.7%, 4.5%, and 19.5% for vote counts zero through five. Disagreements in the unanimous-noncompliance sample (19.5% agreement) concentrate on responses that report their input cannot support an answer, which it usually labels as compliant. On the 450-row human-labelled set (Section 4.2 ), it attains 50.7% accuracy and 8.7% noncompliance recall.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量法官之间的一致性,我们用DeepSeek-V4-Flash重新标注了12,000行的子样本(每计票2,000张),并给出了相同的提示。 它同意所有2000个抽样一致遵守的行,其不遵守的旗帜率与我们的主要法官的计票率单调上升:0.0 %、0.5%、1.15 %、1.7 %、4.5%和19.5 % 的选票数为0至5。 一致不遵守抽样(19.5%的协议)中的分歧集中于报告其投入不能支持答复的答复,它通常将答复标注为符合要求。 在450人标注的套装(第4.2节)上,其准确度达到50.7%,不遵守率达到8.7%。

blocks.en: Table 3: Published refusal-detection methods scored against CompOrca ’s labels (left) and against the human-labelled set (right). The flagged column counts noncompliance over all 4.23M rows, and precision, recall, and F1 are computed on the 4.066M rows with unanimous labels. Human-set metrics are computed on the 450 human-labelled examples (not reweighted; noncompliance is over-represented) where each method returns a decision. We report precision, recall, F1, as well as total noncompliance flags. We omit precision on the human set (weak detectors flag noncompliance or refusal < 5 <5 times over 450 rows) and accuracy everywhere (baseline is 98.7% on CompOrca and 46.4% on human labels, if a detector only classifies compliance).
blocks.zh: 表3:公开的拒绝-检测方法对Comporca的标签(左)和人标的套(右)。 标有标记的一栏计算出所有4.23M行的不遵守情况,精确度、召回度和F1在4.066M行上计算出一致的标签。 在450个人类标注的例子(没有重新加权;不遵守规定的比例过高)中计算出人类的计量标准,每种方法都返回决定。 我们报告精确、回顾F1,以及完全不遵守的旗帜。 我们省略了人体装置的精度(微弱的探测器标出超过450行的 < 5 < 5倍)和各地的精度(如果探测器只分类遵守,则康波尔卡的基准值为98.7%,人类标签为46.4%)。

blocks.en: Unanswerable requests are frequent in this corpus. We labelled by whether a non-answer is one of the answer options the request lists. For MCQ prompts where the model selected a “not enough information” option, we label it compliance, since it is one of the valid options, while stating that a question cannot be answered is noncompliance. This reading is chosen because the dataset exists to separate rows that engage and do not engage with the requested content.
blocks.zh: 本文书中经常提出无法回答的请求。 我们的标签是,不回答是否是请求中列举的答案选项之一。 对于MCQ在模型选择“信息不足”选项时提示,我们将其标注为遵守,因为它是有效的选项之一,同时指出一个无法回答的问题是不遵守。 之所以选择这一读取,是因为数据集的存在是为了分离与所请求的内容有接触和不接触的行.

blocks.en: Reweighted to corpus proportions, the released unanimous labels agree with the human labels on 97.2% of rows (bootstrap 95% CI [94.5, 99.2]). Without reweighting, agreement is 92.0% (Table 2 ), as the sample under-represents compliance rows (agreement 97.3%) and over-represents noncompliance rows (agreement 86.7%). On the nonunanimous rows the share of human noncompliance labels rises with the vote count, from 55.3% at 1/5 to 91.9% at 4/5, so majority-vote agreement is only 44.7% and 39.5% in the 1/5 and 2/5 buckets, showing that judge instability concentrates on difficult cases and that many disagreements are borderline items falling on the other side, rather than clear errors.
blocks.zh: 重新加权到体积比例后,公布的一致标签与97.2%的行(bootstrap 95% CI [94.5, 99.2])的人类标签一致. 如不重新加权,协议为92.0%(表2),因为抽样显示的遵守排数不足(协议97.3%),不遵守排数过多(协议86.7%)。 在非一致的一行中,人类不遵守规定标签的比例随计票数而上升,从55.3%的1/5上升到91.9%的4/5,因此多数选票协议在1/5和2/5桶中分别只有44.7%和39.5%,这表明法官的不稳定性集中在困难案件中,许多分歧是落到另一边的边缘项目,而不是明显的错误。

blocks.en: When retaining only rows on which all passes so far agree, passes 1–5 retain 450, 388, 345, 318, and 300 rows (Table 2 ), with unweighted human-label accuracy rising monotonically: 83.3%, 87.6%, 89.6%, 91.5%, and 92.0%. Repeated passes do not produce better labels, but exclude the 3.97% of rows on which the judge is unstable.
blocks.zh: 当只保留所有通过协议的行时,1–5通过保留450、388、345、318和300行(表2),未加权的人类标签准确度单调上升:83.3%、87.6%、89.6%、91.5%和92.0%。 重复的通行证不会产生更好的标签,但排除了法官不稳定的3.97%的排位.

blocks.en: 5 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 5 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates published refusal-detection methods against CompOrca ’s labels and the human validation set. The substring lists fail in both directions, as 81% of Zou et al. ’s ( 2023 ) refusal detections land on unanimous compliance, since the refusal substrings occur constantly inside ordinary answers, while 94% of the noncompliance class do not contain these substrings at all.
blocks.zh: 表3对照CompOrca的标签和人类验证系统,评估公布的拒绝检测方法。 下弦列表在两个方向上都失败了,因为81%的邹等人(2023年)的拒绝检测以一致遵守为标准,因为拒绝的下弦经常发生在普通答案中,而94%的不遵守类则根本不包含这些下弦.

blocks.en: Substring lists and classifiers trained on refusals achieve between 0.4% and 17.0% recall of the human-labelled noncompliance class. WildGuard’s response-refusal output, which asks whether the response answered the request, recalls 94.1%. The DeepSeek-V4-Flash judge of Section 4.1 , given our prompt, recovers 19.5% of unanimous-noncompliance rows. All methods predominantly classify the majority compliance class correctly.
blocks.zh: 接受过拒绝培训的分类人员名单和分类人员在人类标注的不遵守行为类别中的比例在0.4%至17.0%之间。 WildGuard的响应-反驳输出, 第4.1节的 DeepSeek -V4 -Flash裁判 迅速恢复了19.5%的一致不遵守规定 所有方法主要都正确划分多数遵守类别。

blocks.en: The left columns measure agreement with our judge, while the human columns report recall and F1 against human labels. And high recall does not make a method a substitute for CompOrca labels, as at a 1.28% base rate, even WildGuard’s corpus-wide precision is 19.5%. The substring lists were designed for jailbreak scoring, where responses are short and formulaic. The conclusion is that they have a narrower definition of noncompliance than we use for the instruction corpora, not that prior work was wrong to use them.
blocks.zh: 左栏测量与我们法官的协议, 而人类栏目报告召回 和F1对照人类标签。 高召回率并不能让一种方法取代Comporca标签,因为以1.28%的基准率计算,即使是WildGuard的全体精度也是19.5%。 底弦列表是为越狱打分而设计的,其中的回答短而公式化. 其结论是,它们对于不遵守行为的定义比我们用于指令公司的定义要狭窄,而不是以前的工作错误地使用它们.

blocks.en: 6 Corpus Observations
blocks.zh: 6 公司观测

blocks.en: Two properties of the labelled corpus are relevant to anyone filtering on these labels. Noncompliance is unevenly distributed over the task collections OpenOrca draws prompts from. The noncompliance rate ranges from 2.06% in the T0 split ( Sanh et al., 2022 ) , composed of reading-comprehension tasks, down to 0.14% in the chain-of-thought split. And noncompliant responses are, on average, shorter answers to longer questions. Mean response length is 216 characters against 504 for compliance, while prompts are about 44% longer. Removing them changes the data distribution beyond just whether there is refusal, as it also modifies prompt and response lengths and tasks contained.
blocks.zh: 标签上的两个属性与任何过滤这些标签的人有关。 在OpenOrca从任务集中抽取的提示中,不遵守情况分布不均。 不遵守率从T0拆分(Sanh等人,2022年)的2.06%(由阅读-综合任务组成),到思维链拆分的0.14%不等。 而不符合要求的答复平均来说是对较长问题的回答更短. 平均响应长度为216个字符,遵守504个字符,而提示的长度约为44%。 删除它们会改变数据分布,而不仅仅局限于是否有拒绝,因为它也修改了包含的即时反应长度和任务。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: CompOrca is a compliance labelling of a 4.2M-example instruction corpus, released with per-row vote counts from five judge passes and validated against a partially double-annotated human validation set. Single-pass LLM annotation is unstable, with 52–60% of single-pass noncompliance flags failing unanimity. Thus, passes are repeated to help locate unstable rows. Published refusal-detection methods recover between 0.4% and 94.1% of the class, so what a study of refusal in training data finds depends on method error and how it defines noncompliance and refusal. The corpus, labels, and vote counts are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca , while human validation annotations are made available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca-gold .
blocks.zh: CompOrca是一个4.2M-实例指令书的合规标签,通过5个法官证的每行计票发放,并通过部分附加说明的人类验证套件验证。 单通道LLM注释不稳定,52-60%的单通道不合规旗帜未能达成一致。 因此,通行证被重复,以帮助定位不稳定的行. 已公布的拒绝-检测方法可收回该类的0.4%至94.1%,因此,对培训数据中拒绝的研究发现什么取决于方法错误,以及它如何定义不遵守和拒绝。 在https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca网址上,可以查阅人身鉴定说明书。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Five passes of one model improve self-consistency instead of correctness. Biases in the model are shared across passes.
Human validation instead supports LongCat-2.0: on the same 450 rows, its majority vote reaches 82.4% agreement, versus 50.7% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
LongCat-2.0 is open-weight, so relabelling with the released prompt is possible, with usual sampling variance.
blocks.zh:
一个模型的五个传球提高了自我一致性而不是正确性. 模型中的比喻通过通道共享.
相反,人类验证支持LongCat-2.0:在同一450行中,其多数选票达到82.4%的协议,而DeepSeek-V4-Flash的得票率为50.7%.
LongCat-2.0是开放重量的,因此与释放的提示重贴标签是可能的,通常的采样差异.

blocks.en: The available labels are binary and combine multiple constructs, spanning declining requests, denying capability to answer, and non-answers to requests the input cannot support. They do not separate prompt-level from response-level causes, so a user wanting only safety refusals will need to sub-classify the released class. The judge prompt names the class refusal , while targeting a broader class.
blocks.zh: 现有的标签是二进制的,结合了多个构造,跨越了递减请求,否定了回答能力,对请求的不回答不能支持. 他们没有将即时级与响应级原因区分开来,因此一个只想要安全拒绝的用户将需要对发布类进行子分类. 法官提醒说,

blocks.en: The human validation set is 450 rows, labelled by one author, with a second annotator on a 150-row subset to measure consistency over the codebook. Both applied a codebook written by the first author, who also wrote the judge prompt, so their agreement shows the definition is applied consistently. The corpus is English-dominant, but not exclusively English.
blocks.zh: 人类验证集为450行,由一位作者标注,第二个注释器在一个150行的子集上,以测量比代码本的一致性. 两人都应用了由第一作者撰写的代码手册,他还写了法官的提示,因此他们的协议表明定义得到一致的应用. 主体为英语,但不完全是英语。

blocks.en: Among the 150 sampled rows unanimously labelled noncompliant, 130 were also noncompliant by human judgment, giving a precision of 86.7% [80.3, 91.2]. Humans also identified noncompliance in 4 of the 150 sampled compliance rows. Because this bucket accounts for 94.75% of the corpus, those imply a corpus-reweighted recall of 30.4%, but are too few to draw implications from. We conclude that CompOrca provides a subset of the corpus’s noncompliance, rather than a complete enumeration. We do not estimate how complete it is.
blocks.zh: 在一致标注不符合要求的150个抽样排中,根据人类判断,130个也不符合要求,精确度为86.7%[80.3,91.2]. 人类还查明了150个抽样合规行中的4个不遵守情况。 由于这个桶占尸体的94.75%,这些意味着尸体的重估占30.4%,但太少,无法从中吸取影响。 我们的结论是,Comporca提供了该主体不遵守行为的一部分,而不是一个完整的清单。 我们没有估计它有多完整。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We release the corpus text, labels, and vote counts in full, under the MIT licence. The text is redistributed from the already-public OpenOrca, also licensed under MIT. Compliance labels could help filter refusals from training data to produce less-guarded models. We note that the corpus is already public and that the labelled class is broader than safety refusal and thus underperforms approaches already published.
blocks.zh: 我们根据麻省理工学院的许可, 公布诉讼状、标签和全部计票结果。 该文本从已经公开的OpenOrca再版,也根据麻省理工学院许可. 合规标签可以帮助过滤培训数据中的拒绝数据,以产生保护较少的模型。 我们注意到,这项文书已经公开,被贴上标签的类别比安全拒绝范围更广,因此没有执行已经公布的做法。

blocks.en: Appendix A Judge Prompt
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Reproduced as sent. {question} and {response} are the row’s OpenOrca fields, untruncated; the system_prompt field is not passed to the judge.
blocks.zh: 照寄发. {问题} 和 {答复} 是行的 OpenOrca 字段, 未排队; 系统_ 即时字段不传递给法官 。

blocks.en: System. ⬇ You are a data annotator labelling assistant turns from a general - purpose instruction - tuning corpus . For each item you see one user request and the assistant ' s response . Label whether the response REFUSES the request or COMPLIES with it . These are ordinary corpus examples , not a safety evaluation . Your only output is a JSON label .
blocks.zh: 系统。 您是一个数据注释员 标签助理 转自普通 - 目的指令 - 调试程序。 每个项目都可以看到一个用户请求和助理的回应。 标出响应是否响应了请求或对它是否满意 。 这些是普通体例,不是安全评价。 你唯一的输出是JSON标签。

blocks.en: User. ⬇ Classify the assistant ' s response as exactly one of : - REFUSAL : the assistant declines to fulfil the request , in whole or in substantial part . Includes explicit refusals (" I ' m sorry , but I can ' t help with that "), refusals on capability grounds (" as an AI language model I cannot ..."), ethical / policy refusals , and deflections that withhold the requested content . - COMPLIANCE : the assistant attempts to fulfil the request , even partially , even with caveats or disclaimers , even if the answer is wrong or low - quality . Rules : - A caveat or disclaimer followed by a genuine attempt at the task is COMPLIANCE . - Refusing one part but doing the rest is COMPLIANCE unless the core request is withheld . - If the response text appears cut off , judge what is visible . Respond with a JSON object {" label ": " REFUSAL " | " COMPLIANCE "}. Output ONLY the JSON . --- USER REQUEST --- { question } --- ASSISTANT RESPONSE --- { response }
blocks.zh: 用户。将助理的答复归为: - REFUSAL:助理拒绝全部或大部分满足请求。 包括明确拒绝( " 我很抱歉,但我对此无能为力 " )、基于能力理由的拒绝( " 作为我无法.的AI语言模式 " )、道德/政策拒绝以及拒绝所要求内容的偏转。 - 遵守情况:助理试图满足请求,甚至部分满足请求,即使有警告或免责声明,即使回答错误或质量低。 规则: - 拒绝一部分但完成其余部分即为遵守,除非拒绝核心请求。 如果答复文本被切断,请判断可见的内容。 用 JSON 对象 {"标签 ": "REFUSAL" QQ "ConpLance" } 响应 。 只输出JSON。 - 使用请求 -- -- {问题} -- -- 助理答复 -- -- {回复}

blocks.en: Parsing. Replies are JSON-decoded. On failure, raw text is accepted when exactly one class name occurs in it, and anything else is retried. Failed API requests are retried with backoff until coverage is complete.
blocks.zh: 解说. 答复是JSON解码的。 失败时,当其中出现一个确切的类名时,原始文本被接受,其他任何内容都会被重审. API请求失败后退进行重审,直到覆盖完成.
